issue: Branch code typed inconsistently in POS (e.g. 'b02', 'ILOILO', 'B-03', 'MNL', trailing spaces)
treatment: Trimmed, upper-cased and mapped aliases to master branch_id; unmapped codes fail the load
bi_impact_if_untreated: Sales split across phantom branches; Iloilo/Kalibo/Manila revenue understated

issue: Exact duplicate POS lines created by offline re-sync
treatment: Removed exact duplicates (same txn, time, product, qty, amount)
bi_impact_if_untreated: Bar revenue and transaction counts overstated

issue: Voided items exported as negative-quantity lines
treatment: Each void netted against its original line (618 originals removed); voids tracked separately
bi_impact_if_untreated: Revenue overstated if negatives ignored; product quantities distorted

issue: Member discount applied but member_id not captured at POS
treatment: Classified as member sale (discount proves membership); flagged member_unidentified=1; cashier training recommended
bi_impact_if_untreated: Member share of Bar sales understated; cannot link spend to individual member

issue: Mixed date formats (Kalibo manual sheet uses MM/DD/YYYY)
treatment: Parsed both formats explicitly into ISO dates; rejected rows would be logged
bi_impact_if_untreated: Kalibo payments dropped or assigned to wrong month

issue: Blank plan_id on manually encoded payments
treatment: Inferred plan from amount (each plan has a unique price)
bi_impact_if_untreated: Revenue by plan incomplete; renewal expiry cannot be computed

issue: Memberships expiring in the last 14 days cannot show a renewal yet (right-censoring)
treatment: Excluded from Renewal Rate until the 14-day grace window has passed (observable=0)
bi_impact_if_untreated: Latest month's renewal rate falsely low -> false alarm

treatment: Kept only to compute expiry/renewal; excluded from revenue

issue: Member full names present in source
treatment: Dropped from BI dataset (not needed for any KPI); member_id kept as pseudonymous key
